name: free-rein
description: Free Rein's core: reads an AI agent's harness, evaluates its pieces, plays out situations, and writes upgrades. Tested by its own behaviour tests and saved outputs (test/golden).

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test out/test/*.test.js out/test/behaviour/*.test.js
scripts.golden: npm run build && FREE_REIN_GOLDEN=1 node --test out/test/golden.test.js out/test/behaviour/harness.test.js
